memory_update.text: AMKR should remain the US-listed reference OSAT for the advanced packaging / FOPLP overflow node, but later layers must separate real AI/HPC packaging revenue from generic OSAT exposure.
KLIC is an underfollowed equipment candidate for advanced packaging because bonding / placement accuracy may be a yield gate for fan-out, flip-chip, and thermo-compression bonding flows.
ONTO is a strong process-control candidate for panel-level packaging because its lithography, inspection, metrology, and software map directly to FOPLP yield and RDL process control.

VECO is an underfollowed CPO-adjacent equipment candidate because InP laser, MOCVD, IBD, wet-processing, and optical-interconnect capacity may become upstream bottlenecks as AI systems migrate toward optical I/O.

Need a later search pass for non-US-listed Asian OSATs and FOPLP specialists, including Powertech, ASE, JCET, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Ibiden, Shinko, Unimicron, and packaging material suppliers, because the strongest pure exposure may not be US-listed.

For this node, the highest-value evidence will be customer qualification, advanced-packaging backlog, capex tied to FOPLP or 2.5D/3D, yield milestones, optical-interconnect orders, and AI/HPC revenue disclosure rather than generic packaging language.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the advanced packaging / FOPLP / CPO node using a two-lane funnel. The reference lane keeps one direct OSAT anchor, Amkor, because it maps most directly to advanced packaging overflow and US domestic packaging capacity. The underfollowed lane prioritizes less obvious equipment and process-control chokepoints: Kulicke & Soffa for advanced packaging bonding / placement tools, Onto Innovation for panel-level lithography / inspection / metrology, and Veeco for upstream InP / photonics equipment tied to optical interconnect and eventual CPO scaling. Claims are research-screening hypotheses, not recommendations. Later layers should verify AI/HPC revenue contribution, customer qualifications, backlog quality, and whether orders convert into durable pricing power.
